zh: 針對智能計算器新增一輪對抗性審查，專門測試否定詞、互斥方案、百分比更正、退休年齡反轉、負數、超大金額、越界覆蓋率／收益率與 0 年目標等異常輸入。
修正「退休不用保險、改用定投」仍可能因句中出現「保險」而誤判為保險方案；現在會辨識常見否定表達。
修正同一句同時要求「保險還是定投」時系統會暗中偏向其中一種的問題；遇到互斥意圖改為要求使用者自行選方案。
自然語言覆蓋率支援「八成半＝85%」等表達，並在「不是80%，改60%」等明確更正語句中以最後一次比例為準。
修正退休年齡先被強制改寫後才檢查、導致錯誤年齡警告永遠不會觸發的根因；現在先驗證原始輸入，再安全收斂至模型支援範圍並清楚提示。
金額、覆蓋率、收益率與年限加入安全邊界；負數、異常巨大數字與越界參數不再可能傳入核心公式造成溢出或產生看似正常的錯誤結果。
新增 200 組確定性隨機怪輸入壓力測試，所有智能方案的輸出均不得出現 NaN、Infinity、負保費或負本金；完整 Flutter 回歸現為 45 項全部通過。
en: Added a dedicated adversarial review for the Smart Calculator covering negation, mutually exclusive plans, corrected percentages, reversed retirement ages, negative values, huge amounts, out-of-range coverage/returns, and zero-year goals.
Fixed intent parsing where “do not use insurance; use DCA for retirement” could still be routed to insurance simply because the word “insurance” appeared in the sentence.
Mutually exclusive “insurance or DCA?” requests no longer silently choose one side; the app now asks the user to select the intended plan.
Natural-language coverage parsing now supports expressions such as Chinese “八成半” (85%) and respects explicit corrections such as “not 80%, change it to 60%”.
Fixed the root cause of retirement-age validation being unreachable after the value had already been normalized. Raw input is now validated first, then safely constrained with a visible warning.
Added safe bounds for money, coverage, rates and horizons so negative, extremely large, or out-of-range values cannot overflow core formulas or generate authoritative-looking nonsense.
Added a deterministic 200-case fuzz-style stress test requiring every Smart Calculator metric to remain finite and non-negative. The full Flutter regression suite now has 45 passing tests.
